column1: # Partition table for the Agbau on the ESP32-S3 N16R8 (16MB flash).
# The sampler firmware does NOT use this: it keeps the board definition's
# default_16MB.csv. Only the agbau environments name this file.
# One factory app and no OTA pair. The default table spends 12.5MB on two
# 6.25MB app slots for over-the-air updates this instrument will never do;
# the firmware is under 1MB. That space is the sample kit instead: 8.995MB of
# "samples" uses a custom data subtype (0x40 - 0xFE are reserved for
# applications). Its offset is what the kit image is flashed to:
# Moving it means changing that command too.
